text:
Maya K: Quick sync — we need to open registration for the 'Strategic Playbook' drop-in next week. We have a waitlist of 18; capacity 8 per session. Need rules to gate signups and prioritize renewals/at-risk accounts. Thoughts?
Omar H: +1. Recommend reserving 3 seats for renewal-risk accounts and 1 seat for dedicated customers. Rest open.
Priya R: Agreed. Can we make a quick form field 'renewal risk' checkbox? or use account tag.
Lee S: We should also prioritize customers with Dedicated migration in flight (SLA customers).
Maya K: Proposed policy draft:
- 3 seats = renewal-risk
- 2 seats = Dedicated migration
- 1 seat = partner/customer success escalations
- remaining first-come-first-serve for waitlist
Anyone oppose?
Omar H: LGTM. Also need an APAC-friendly session time. If we do evening PT that's morning AEST.
Priya R: I'll open the Notion registration and add tagging. Link: https://redwood-inference.notion.site/strategic-playbook-reg
Can someone confirm calendar invites will be sent only after approval?
calendar-bot: I can send invites on approval. Use `/schedule approve 1748129876` to trigger.
Lee S: Can eng cover? I can do Tue 7pm PT if someone pairs.
Maya K: Need 2 eng volunteers for Tue 7pm PT. @Omar H @Priya R can you confirm?
Omar H: I can cover Tue 7pm PT.
Priya R: I can be there but might need to drop after 30 mins.
Maya K: Great. I'll update the sign-up flow: require 'customer risk level' and 'migration stage'. We'll run a 15-min triage call for renewal-risk before giving seat.
Priya R: Suggest we DM lead CS contact and ask for one-sentence objective before approving.
Lee S: For tracking, add UTM param to registration link and set a tag in Salesforce: 'playbook-dropin-2024Q2'.
Maya K: I'll create the registration batch: 8 seats per session, keep waitlist open. Can we do auto-accept for 'trusted' customers? maybe 2 seats.
Omar H: Auto-accept okay for customers with NPS >=8? or accounts with less than 2 open tickets.
Maya K: Decision: auto-accept 2 trusted seats (NPS>=8 or <2 incidents), 3 renewal-risk hold, 2 dedicated, 1 escalation. I'll publish.
Priya R: Also capturing feedback. We'll ask 3 quick eval questions after session: usefulness, readiness to proceed, follow-up priority.
calendar-bot: Event created: Strategic Playbook - Tue 2024-06-18 19:00 PT. Guests added on approval.
Maya K: Thanks. Final ask — can someone monitor renewals list and flag accounts to prioritize? @Lee S assign?
Lee S: On it. I'll DM list in 15m.
Omar H: FYI, I'll drop a short checklist for engineers in #eng-support.
Priya R: Tiny note: add 'requires SANDBOX access' checkbox so we can pre-provision demo envs.
Maya K: Good call. We'll close approvals 24h before event. If anyone wants to change the gating rules, say now.
Lee S: No changes from me. :thumbsup:
Maya K: Publishing now — registration live. Please triage approvals into the spreadsheet: https://go.redwood/ps-regs
